name: Designer Assistant
description: Handles the legwork of styling rooms and occasions: sourcing pieces, pulling a look together, buying things, and writing the emails that go with it. Suited to weddings, parties and interiors where someone else placing orders is a help rather than a worry.

official.title: Designer Assistant by Amber
official.description: A designer assistant for spaces, parties, events, and weddings. Helps shop, find pieces, plan the look, make purchases, and send emails.
